extracted.intended_audience: journal peer reviewers using Elsevier's Editorial Manager (Reviewer Hub)
extracted.subtask_description: Guide for reviewers on performing peer review tasks in Elsevier's Editorial Manager: account setup, responding to invitations, managing and completing reviews, structuring review reports, submitting recommendations, and post-review actions (e.g., certificates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Login
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for signing in to Editorial Manager to access review tasks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes troubleshooting ('Having trouble signing in?') and an associated 'Watch video' link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updating account information / Changing your personal information
rubrics_metrics.description: How to update personal and contact information in your reviewer account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under Login & Account; includes a 'Watch video' for guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting unavailable dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Setting dates when you are unavailable to receive or accept review invitations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under Login & Account with an accompanying 'Watch video'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting temporary alternate contact details
rubrics_metrics.description: How to set temporary alternate contact details for your reviewer account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under Login & Account with accompanying video guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to contact Elsevier support
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for contacting Elsevier support if you need help with Editorial Manager.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provided as a support resource and linked video.

rubrics_metrics.name: What is Reviewer Hub?
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of the Reviewer Hub functionality and resources available to reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed in 'Before you begin' as orientation material for reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fundamentals of Peer Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Core principles and expectations of peer review (general fundamentals for reviewers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under 'Before you begin'; no specific guidance text shown on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responding to reviewer invitations in Editorial Manager
rubrics_metrics.description: How to respond to an invitation to review (accept or decline) within Editorial Manager.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is a video titled 'Responding to reviewer invitations in Editorial Manager'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Step-by-step guide for review process
rubrics_metrics.description: Sequential walkthrough of the actions required to complete a review from acceptance to submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under 'Managing your review' as the main article for day-to-day review tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requesting a review deadline extension
rubrics_metrics.description: How to request more time to complete a review when the original deadline is insufficient.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available under 'Managing your review' and referenced as a specific task.

rubrics_metrics.name: Making changes to your completed review in Editorial Manager
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures to amend a review you have already submitted through Editorial Manager.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under 'Managing your review' as a distinct operation reviewers may need.

rubrics_metrics.name: If you can’t complete an accepted review
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on what to do if you have accepted a review but cannot complete it (withdraw, notify editor, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as 'What should I do if I have accepted my review task but I can’t complete it?'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stopping future invitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for reviewers who want to stop being invited to review for Elsevier journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as 'What can I do if I want to stop being invited to review for Elsevier Journals?'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drafting a review report
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on structuring and composing the review report you will provide to authors/editors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under 'Structuring your review' — likely covers content, tone, and organization of reviews (no detailed text shown on this page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Completing a structured review
rubrics_metrics.description: How to fill in any structured review form fields (e.g., ratings, checklists, specific questions) in Editorial Manager.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is a video 'Completing a structured review' and an article 'Completing a structured review' linked from this section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submitting your recommendation and review comments
rubrics_metrics.description: How to record your overall recommendation (accept/revise/reject) and submit your reviewer comments via Editorial Manager.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under 'Structuring your review' with an article on submitting recommendations and comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: How can I submit my review in Editorial Manager?

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a standalone help article and accompanied by a video.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessing other reviewers' comments
